Definition
[induced derivation of $L\in \mathrm{End}(V)$]

Source: petersen:page-0081 ↗ def:pet-ch2-gl-action-tensor-algebra ↗ def:pet-ch2-tensor-derivation

Differentiating the $\mathrm{GL}(V)$-action of subsection 3.1 gives a linear map $\mathrm{End}(V)\to \mathrm{End}(T(V))$, $L\mapsto LT$: on vectors $Lv=L(v)$; on $1$-forms $L\phi =-\phi \circ L$; and on general tensors, \[ L(v_1\otimes \cdots \otimes v_s\otimes \phi _1\otimes \cdots \otimes \phi _t) = \sum _{i=1}^sv_1\otimes \cdots \otimes L(v_i)\otimes \cdots \otimes v_s\otimes \phi _1\otimes \cdots \otimes \phi _t \] \[ -\sum _{j=1}^tv_1\otimes \cdots \otimes v_s\otimes \phi _1\otimes \cdots \otimes (\phi _j\circ L)\otimes \cdots \otimes \phi _t. \]
